feedback_by_option.fil: Napuputol ang pressure kapag inangat ang tela. Iwan ang unang tela at idiin nang matatag.
feedback_by_option.en: Lifting the cloth interrupts pressure. Keep the first cloth in place and press firmly.

feedback_by_option.fil: Tama. Protektahan ang kamay, saka idiin nang matatag ang malinis na tela.
feedback_by_option.en: Correct. Protect your hands, then apply firm direct pressure with clean material.

feedback_by_option.fil: Hindi ginagamit ang rutinang herbal wash, at hindi matatag na pressure ang maluwag na takip.
feedback_by_option.en: Routine herbal wash is not used, and a loose cover is not firm pressure.

feedback_by_option.fil: Naaantala ang pressure kapag tinanggal ang unang tela. Magpatong na lamang ng tela.
feedback_by_option.en: Removing the first cloth interrupts pressure. Add material on top instead.

feedback_by_option.fil: Huwag umasa sa mahinang pressure sa malubhang pagdurugo. Idiin pa rin nang matatag.
feedback_by_option.en: Do not rely on gentle pressure for severe bleeding. Keep pressing firmly.

feedback_by_option.fil: Tama. Magdagdag ng tela habang tuloy ang pressure, at humingi ng agarang tulong sa tuloy-tuloy na pagdurugo.
feedback_by_option.en: Correct. Add material while maintaining pressure, and activate urgent help for persistent bleeding.
